workarounds.symptom: Self-update skips the compatible Node selected by asdf in the project

Target files: implementations/cli/smoke/update-current.smoke.ts, implementations/cli/src/command.ts, implementations/cli/src/commands/update-process.ts. workarounds.symptom: Self-update cannot start npm when the relative Node directory contains a colon

When `.` was the only `PATH` entry that could find Node, `cotal update --self` found npm but could not start it from a directory such as `native:tools`. The updater runs npm outside the project, and the absolute Node directory cannot be added to `PATH` because it contains a colon. (Ref: https://github.com/Cotal-AI/Cotal/pull/9900)
